mapper.select: select id, chat_type, chat_name, group_id, create_time, update_time from te_chat where chat_type = 2 and group_id = #{groupId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into te_chat (chat_type, chat_name, group_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{chatType}, #{chatName}, #{groupId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select c.id as chatId, c.chat_type as chatType, c.group_id as groupId, case when c.chat_type = 2 then coalesce(g.group_name, c.chat_name) else (select u.nick_name from te_chat_member om join sys_user u on u.user_id = om.user_id where om.chat_id = c.id and om.user_id != #{userId} limit 1) end as displayName, (select count(*) from te_message um where um.chat_id = c.id and um.id > me.last_read_msg_id and um.sender_id != #{userId}) as unreadCount, lm.content as lastContent, lm.sender_id as lastSenderId, lm.send_time as lastTime from te_chat c join te_chat_member me on me.chat_id = c.id and me.user_id = #{userId} left join te_group g on g.id = c.group_id left join te_message lm on lm.id = (select max(m2.id) from te_message m2 where m2.chat_id = c.id) order by coalesce(lm.send_time, c.create_time) desc
mapper.update: update te_chat set update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
